artifacts.summary: Maps task 403's three open questions onto existing codebase mechanisms: verify-deploy.sh's --only-gate/--skip-slow gate selection, plan-format.md's Verification Tiers, deploy-baseline-lib.sh's confirm+attribute pipeline (built for the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint, reusable for per-task attribution), skill-orchestrate's Move 4/5 seam as the right site for a new once-per-invocation shared-gate stage, and a directly relevant prior rejection (single-capture Gate-8 sharing across a deploy boundary) that does not block this design but must not be re-triggered.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/lib/deploy-baseline-lib.sh exports a reusable confirm-then-attribute pipeline for verify-deploy.sh findings: deploy_findings_snapshot (capture, folding exit-2 into a sentinel FINDING line), deploy_baseline_new_findings (comm -13 identity set difference, never count-based), deploy_baseline_confirm_new_findings (re-run to drop flaky candidates), deploy_baseline_unattributable_findings (fail-safe-toward-blocking identifier match against a modified_files JSON array), and deploy_baseline_self_attributable_findings (fail-safe-toward-NOT-withholding per-task variant). Built for the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint, but this is the right template for ANY future problem of attributing a shared/batch-level check's findings back to individual tasks by file overlap.

A prior task rejected sharing a single Gate-8 (run-all.sh) capture across the Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint's own pre/post pair, because ~41 of ~105 shell suites use a deploy-tree-first/source-store-fallback resolution pattern -- they prefer the DEPLOYED copy of their subject-under-test, so a pre-redeploy and post-redeploy capture are provably not interchangeable across a deploy boundary. This rejection does NOT generalize to sharing one gate run across sibling TASKS within an already-stable (non-deploy-boundary-straddling) tree -- the two situations differ on the load-bearing axis that made sharing unsafe in the rejected case. Future designs proposing to reuse/share a verify-deploy.sh capture must check which side of this distinction they are on before assuming the rejection applies.

skill-orchestrate's Move 4 (Branch/loop-exit) and Move 5 (Conclusion, documented as 'runs exactly once per invocation, after Move 4 finalizes') form the established seam for adding a NEW once-per-invocation, post-dispatch engine stage. context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md is the worked precedent for this shape (Overview / Evidence Base-Trigger / Executable Stage Body), including the explicit norm of keeping a new stage's mechanism disjoint from Move 5's existing issue-log-aggregation body even when both share the same trigger point ('Coexistence Boundary' pattern) rather than folding a new concern into an existing stage's body.
